name: Tablet of Gilgamesh
lore: The Epic of Gilgamesh is the oldest known work of literature — a Sumerian king's quest for immortality, written on clay tablets four thousand years ago. Gilgamesh was two-thirds god and one-third man, and his story teaches that true immortality lies not in living forever, but in the deeds that outlive you. This ring carries a fragment of that first epic — knowledge and endurance in equal measure. +1 INT, +1 CON.
